globalNotes: Dark theme throughout (near-black background ~#0E1419 at top fading to ~#0A0E12 lower). Sticky top nav bar ("TODAY" + back chevron + info circle) stays fixed while content scrolls; status bar (09:34 / 09:35, signal, wifi, battery 39%) is iOS system, not app. A floating circular WHOOP "W" logo button (purple/blue gradient ring) is pinned bottom-right over all scroll positions — this is the AI/Coach launcher and is EXCLUDED. Scroll order top-to-bottom: big Strain ring -> metric rows card (HR Zones 1-3, HR Zones 4-5, Strength Activity Time, Steps) -> "Today vs last 30 days" legend pill -> recovery/strain guidance promo card -> "Weekly Trends" section header -> STRAIN weekly bar chart -> HR ZONES 1-3 weekly chart -> HR ZONES 4-5 weekly chart -> STEPS weekly chart -> CALORIES weekly chart -> STRENGTH ACTIVITY TIME weekly chart. All weekly charts share x-axis Wed24/Thu25/Fri26/Sat27/Sun28/Mon29/Tue30, with Tue30 (today) highlighted by a translucent vertical column band and bold white label. Section header fonts are condensed bold uppercase (WHOOP DIN-style). Today is Tue 30.
excluded: Floating circular WHOOP 'W' gradient logo button pinned bottom-right (AI/Coach 'Ask WHOOP Coach' launcher) — present in all 5 scroll positions
'EXPLORE YOUR STRAIN INSIGHTS ->' link inside the guidance promo card routes into a coach/insights flow — link itself can render but the coach destination is excluded

layout.name: Top nav bar
layout.description: Fixed header. Left: back chevron '<' (white, thin). Center: title 'TODAY' in white condensed bold uppercase, letter-spaced, ~16px. Right: circular 'i' info icon outlined in grey/white, ~28px diameter. Bar background matches page ~#0E1419, no divider.
layout.interaction: Back chevron pops to previous screen; 'i' opens an info/explainer sheet about the strain screen. 'TODAY' likely opens a date picker / day switcher.

layout.name: Day Strain ring (big)
layout.description: Large circular progress ring centered near top. Ring track is dark grey (#2A2E33) with subtle segment notches/gaps; a thin BLUE tick marker sits at the very top (12 o'clock, ~#4AA3DF) marking start/now, and a small WHITE tick sits at lower-left (~7-8 o'clock) marking an optimal-strain target. The ring is mostly unfilled (strain only 0.1). Inside, stacked and centered: faint grey 'WHOOP' wordmark (~#5A6068, letter-spaced) at top of inner area, then a very large white '0.1' (~96px, extra-bold), then 'STRAIN' in white condensed bold uppercase (~16px) below it. A small upward triangle/caret pointer sits just below the ring pointing down into the metrics card (connects ring to card).
layout.interaction: Static display of current Day Strain; tapping ring/area may open strain detail. Blue tick = current/now marker; white tick = strain target marker.

layout.name: Metrics card (4 rows)
layout.description: Rounded-corner dark card (~#1B2026) containing four metric rows separated by thin hairline dividers. Each row: left icon (grey line-art) + label (white condensed bold uppercase, ~15px) on the left; right side has a large white value (~26px bold) with a tiny colored trend caret to its right, and a smaller grey baseline value beneath the big value (right-aligned).
layout.interaction: Each row tappable -> drills into that metric's detail/weekly trend.

layout.name: Row: HEART RATE ZONES 1-3
layout.description: Icon: heart with horizontal line through it (grey outline). Label 'HEART RATE ZONES 1-3'. Big value '0:00' (white). Trend caret: small DOWN triangle, ORANGE (~#E8943A) pointing down, to the right of the value. Baseline below: '0:07' (grey, smaller) = last-30-day average. Down orange caret means today is below baseline.
layout.interaction: Tap -> HR Zones 1-3 detail / weekly chart.

layout.name: Row: HEART RATE ZONES 4-5
layout.description: Icon: heart outline (grey). Label 'HEART RATE ZONES 4-5'. Big value '0:00' (white). Trend indicator: small grey DOT (no arrow — equal to / no change vs baseline). Baseline below: '0:00' (grey).
layout.interaction: Tap -> HR Zones 4-5 detail / weekly chart.

layout.name: Row: STRENGTH ACTIVITY TIME
layout.description: Icon: dumbbell (grey line-art). Label 'STRENGTH ACTIVITY TIME'. Big value '0:00' (white). Trend indicator: small grey DOT (no change). Baseline below: '0:00' (grey).
layout.interaction: Tap -> Strength Activity Time detail / weekly chart.

layout.name: Row: STEPS
layout.description: Icon: running shoe / footstep motion (grey line-art). Label 'STEPS'. Big value '262' (white bold). Trend caret: small DOWN triangle ORANGE (~#E8943A) to the right. Baseline below: '6,094' (grey, smaller) = last-30-day average. Down orange caret = today below baseline.

layout.name: Comparison legend pill
layout.description: Full-width rounded dark pill (~#0A0D11, darker than card). Left: a green UP triangle (~#5FC97E) and an orange DOWN triangle (~#E8943A) stacked/paired as a legend glyph. Then text: 'Today' in white bold, followed by 'vs. last 30 days' in grey. Explains the trend carets above (green up = above 30-day baseline, orange down = below).

layout.name: Strain guidance promo card
layout.description: Rounded card with a thin gradient border (teal-to-purple ~#3FB6C9 -> #7B61FF). Body text in white (~17px regular, multi-line): 'Your body is signaling it's ready to perform today. Aim for moderate Day Strain between 10.0 and 14.0 today to optimize your training and workouts.' Below the body, a link row: 'EXPLORE YOUR STRAIN INSIGHTS' in purple condensed bold uppercase (~#7B61FF) with a purple right-arrow '->'.
literals: Your body is signaling it's ready to perform today. Aim for moderate Day Strain between 10.0 and 14.0 today to optimize your training and workouts.
layout.interaction: 'EXPLORE YOUR STRAIN INSIGHTS ->' navigates to a strain insights / coach flow (destination excluded).

layout.name: Weekly Trends section header
layout.description: Large white title 'Weekly Trends' in mixed-case bold (NOT uppercase, ~28px, sans bold). Left-aligned, sits above the stack of weekly charts.

layout.name: STRAIN weekly chart card
layout.description: Rounded dark card. Header row: 'STRAIN' (white condensed bold uppercase, left) + right chevron '>' (grey). Vertical bar chart, 7 bars. Bars blue (~#2E9BE6) with the day's strain value labeled in blue above each bar. Faint horizontal gridlines. X-axis day labels below each bar. Today (Tue 30) column has a translucent grey vertical highlight band behind it and bold white day label.
layout.interaction: Tap card / '>' -> Strain weekly trend detail.
